our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion identifies the generative AI industry, including its compute services, rather than every historical use of AI.
The dollar figures are US dollars and describe realized annual revenue, not year-end annualized run rates.
'Theoretical revenues' and the surrounding reliance on reporting indicate estimates rather than a stated GAAP or IFRS aggregate.
The explicit inclusion of upstream compute requires a transparent aggregation method. No arbitrary percentage tolerance is added to 'around'.
The named company figures are components; verifying them alone does not verify the industry total.
criteria.support_condition: A transparent, sufficiently comprehensive estimate of calendar-2025 realized revenue for the stated industry scope places the total reasonably near $65 billion and substantiates the named components.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A comparable comprehensive estimate or defensible bound places revenue materially outside an ordinary approximation to $65 billion, or establishes a material error in a named component.
